issue.title: period-notes stub-fill test reads the real date and fails once 2026-W47 is past
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-pf.1.1.5 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the
bob-cli-pf.1.1 land agent. Not caused by epic bob-cli-pf.1.1: neither the test nor
`292b-plugin-period-notes.js` / `296f-plugin-nav-groups-api.js` changed in that epic.

## What fails

Repo: bob-plugins (linked), master c8deb534.
`node --test scripts/test-ledger-tools-period-notes.cjs` fails 16/17 every run from
2026-11-23 on:

    ✖ a stubbed period note is filled once through ensure -d; bob scaffolds never cascade
    expected spawns [["periods","ensure","-q","-f","json","-d","2026-11-16"]], actual []

## Root cause

The test stubs `2026/2026-W47.md` and expects `periodNotesFillStub` to spawn
`bob periods ensure -d 2026-11-16`. The fill routes through
`periodNotesEnsureForPath`, whose pre-adoption guard calls
`navGroupsPathIsPreAdoption(path)`. That reads the real date through
`navGroupsTodayText()` (`296f-plugin-nav-groups-api.js:43`), so once W47 ends
(2026-11-22) the harness treats W47 as a pre-adoption past target and refuses
without spawning.

## Why it is not a flake

Deterministic: it fails on every isolated run on today's date. With `Date` pinned
to 2026-11-18 by a `--require` preload, the unchanged file passes 17/17.

## Fix

Pin the harness clock in this test, for example set
`harnessed.plugin.navGroupsTodayOverride = "2026-11-18"` (the existing override hook),
or use a fixture week relative to a fixed today. Keep the "fill once, scaffolds never
cascade" assertions unchanged. Same family as the closed date-pinning fixes
bob-cli-ff and bob-cli-et.
